description: Listed building consent for erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to be used as garden room and bicycle store to front garden of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings A666/L1, 002-01, 002-03, 002-04, 002-05, 002-06, PL3/01 and PL3/M01, Photograph Sheets and Heritage Statement and Design and Access Statement, all received on 03/03/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surface of the outbuilding and cycle storage unit hereby permitted shall be as shown on the approved drawings/ supporting material.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 37 Priory Avenue, W4 1TZ, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
